'''Tsyk''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EA" /> located in the eponymous [[Tsyk system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and lay along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Hollastin Run/Legends|Hollastin Run]], which connected it to the worlds of [[Hollastin]] and [[Circumtore/Legends|Circumtore]].<ref name="EA" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Tsyklen]].<ref name="HA" /><ref name="EA" /> Their homeworld was considered part of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] as early as [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], and the species was counted as a prized client species by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who controlled the region. By that time, Tsyk became a gloomy, polluted world.<ref name="EA" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], in which the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded and sought to conquer [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] to [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Yuuzhan Vong [[Attack on the Tsyk system|attacked]] Tsyk between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. By 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], Tsyk was held by the invaders.<ref name="EA" /> At some point after the Yuuzhan Vong's defeat at the end of 29 ABY,<ref name="NEC" /> the planet reverted to being part of Hutt Space. It remained so in [[137 ABY]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tsyk was first mentioned in the novel ''[[The Hutt Gambit]]'', published in [[1997]], although no information about the planet itself was provided.<ref name="HA" /> More information about this world was later presented in the sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', released in [[2009]].<ref name="EA" />
